note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #17, Q4 2025 Harassment; exports mexico_2025_q4safety_harassment.csv from mexico_safety_4q2025.dta, built from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1225.csv imported case(lower), id = _n within the quarter) keeps INEGI columns bp4_1_1..bp4_1_9 and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); the bookmark is identical to Q2 2025's #8 apart from input dataset and output name (diffed). Recodes: bp4_1_1..3 9 -> missing (l.220-222, all quarters but 2024 Q1), bp4_1_4..9 9 -> missing (l.232-237). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own 2025 Q4 data dictionary (1225) labels each BP4_1_n 'Situaciones de acoso: <situation>'; after stripping that prefix 7/9 labels are character-identical to the shipped item_text and to questionnaire 4.1 options 1-9 in the same order; the other two are the same situation with one punctuation/accent difference each (BP4_1_4 label has a comma after 'sexuales', BP4_1_9 label has 'videos' accented) -- see Step 3b. Cross-check (route 9 style, server-side GROUP BY item,resp on the live table, no export): all 18 live item x level counts equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q4 CSV after the .do's recode, 18/18 (1/2: bp4_1_1 2247/21659, bp4_1_2 174/23733, bp4_1_3 380/23526, bp4_1_4 1309/22592, bp4_1_5 64/23847, bp4_1_6 545/23364, bp4_1_7 517/23381, bp4_1_8 932/22964, bp4_1_9 61/23835); code 9 set missing 17/16/17/22/12/14/25/27/27 (177 cells); no blanks, no skip routing into 4.1. Raw 23923 rows (PER=0425 on every row, INEGI template quirk as in the siblings); live COUNT(*) 215130 = 9 x 23923 - 177; live distinct ids 23914 = 23923 - 9 respondents coded 9 on all nine items; no missing resp, no duplicate id x item -- not truncated. Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered 2025 Q4 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the dictionary labels where they differ; all 13 Spanish strings (CP4, 4.1 stem, 9 options, 'Si'/'No') equal the trim4 text layer after whitespace and dot-leader normalisation (asserted in the build script), and a 200-dpi render of p.6 was read to confirm items 4, 8 and 9. Step 3b, 2025 Q4 vs 2025 Q2 (batch_695), checked not assumed, against both text layers and both renders: ONE print change -- item 9 (bp4_1_9) 'videos' unaccented in 2025 Q4 ('Le obligaron a mirar escenas o actos sexuales o pornograficos (fotos, revistas, videos o peliculas)') where 2025 Q2 and 2024 Q4 print the accented 'vídeos'; shipped as printed in Q4 2025. CP4, 4.1 stem, items 1-8 and 'Si'/'No' identical to 2025 Q2. Step 3b, 2025 Q4 vs 2024 Q4 (batch_687): the same two changes 2025 Q2 already made, both shipped as printed -- (a) CP4 'Ahora, quisiera preguntarle sobre situaciones...' -> 'Ahora, le preguntare sobre situaciones...'; (b) item 4 '...sobre usted, con insinuaciones sexuales, insultos u ofensas sexuales, a traves del celular ... redes sociales (como Facebook, ...' -> '...sobre usted con insinuaciones, insultos u ofensas sexuales a traves del celular ... redes sociales (Facebook, ...' -- plus the item 9 accent change above. Diccionario 1225 vs the print: BP4_1_4 label '...ofensas sexuales, a traves...' (comma not printed; render-confirmed no comma), BP4_1_9 label 'videos' accented (print unaccented); the 0625 diccionario carried the 2024 item-4 wording, so 1225's is a third variant of that label. Labels only, not shipped text. Kept as printed: '(a)'/'(o)' gender fills, 'videos' unaccented in items 8 and 9, 'etcetera' in items 4 and 8. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question number 4.1, option numbers, dot leaders and I__I boxes, interviewer direction 'MUESTRE LA TARJETA "D" Y REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION'. Tarjeta D is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure (as batch_687/695): one section (all nine items are options of question 4.1); CP4 in instructions, the 4.1 stem in section_prompt. Options: 1 = 'Si', 2 = 'No' printed in the questionnaire and identical in all 9 catalogos; 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (18/18). The shipped file is batch_695's (2025 Q2) with table, section_id, instrument ('segundo' -> 'cuarto trimestre') and bp4_1_9's item_text accent changed -- diff after those substitutions is empty. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_695 for every field (bp4_1_9's English already read 'videos'); nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. Step 3b table check: live items match question 4.1 exactly (9 = 9). Dictionary Description ('harassment and intimidation in public spaces') could say sexual harassment -- every item is sexual in content, and item 4/8 are online, not in a public space; the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q4 (diciembre 2025, file suffix 1225) wave -- same defect as the siblings. table_context.R was NOT run as-is (it calls irw_fetch, a whole-table export); the batch_702/703 scratch copy that swaps that call for irw_table_sets() ran the dictionary/index-status sections unchanged (no STOP; not in Sheet1 or any cross-check tab). validate_items.R --table-sets: PASS (9 items, resp {1,2}).
